```{r}

# INTERACTIVE HEALTH EQUALITY VS HAPPINESS BOXPLOT

# PART 1: Load packages

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(shiny)
library(countrycode)


# PART 2: Import dataset

# Search for the dataset inside your project folders
files <- list.files(
  path = "~",
  pattern = "^wdi_clean\\.csv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("Cannot find wdi_clean.csv. Check your Files tab.")
}

data <- read_csv(files[1], show_col_types = FALSE)


# PART 3: Prepare the data

graph_data <- data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(health_equality),
    !is.na(happiness),
    !is.na(year)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Continent = countrycode(
      iso3c, "iso3c", "continent"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Continent))


# PART 4: Create the Shiny interface

ui <- fluidPage(

  titlePanel("Health Equality and Happiness Across Countries"),

  p("Explore whether countries with greater health
    equality tend to report higher happiness scores."),

  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(

      sliderInput(
        "year",
        "Select Year:",
        min = min(graph_data$year),
        max = max(graph_data$year),
        value = 2022,
        step = 1,
        sep = ""
      ),

      selectInput(
        "continent",
        "Select Continent:",
        choices = c(
          "All Continents",
          sort(unique(graph_data$Continent))
        )
      ),

      actionButton("reset", "Reset Filters")
    ),

    mainPanel(

      plotlyOutput("health_boxplot", height = "550px"),

      h4("Summary Statistics"),

      tableOutput("summary_table"),

      textOutput("country_count")
    )
  )
)


# PART 5: Create Shiny server

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  filtered_data <- reactive({

    df <- graph_data %>%
      filter(year == input$year)

    if (input$continent != "All Continents") {
      df <- df %>%
        filter(Continent == input$continent)
    }

    # Divide countries into three equality groups
    # based on the selected data

    if (nrow(df) >= 3) {

      df <- df %>%
        mutate(
          Health_Group = ntile(health_equality, 3),
          Health_Group = factor(
            Health_Group,
            levels = c(1, 2, 3),
            labels = c(
              "Lower Equality",
              "Middle Equality",
              "Higher Equality"
            )
          )
        )

    }

    df
  })


  # PART 6: Interactive boxplot

  output$health_boxplot <- renderPlotly({

    df <- filtered_data()

    validate(
      need(
        nrow(df) >= 3,
        "Not enough country data for this selection."
      )
    )

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        Hover = paste0(
          "Country: ", country,
          "<br>Year: ", year,
          "<br>Continent: ", Continent,
          "<br>Health Equality: ",
          round(health_equality, 2),
          "<br>Happiness Score: ",
          round(happiness, 2)
        )
      )

    p <- ggplot(
      df,
      aes(
        x = Health_Group,
        y = happiness,
        fill = Health_Group
      )
    ) +

      geom_boxplot(
        alpha = 0.65,
        outlier.shape = NA
      ) +

      geom_point(
        aes(text = Hover),
        position = position_jitter(
          width = 0.15,
          height = 0
        ),
        alpha = 0.65,
        size = 2
      ) +

      labs(
        title = paste(
          "Health Equality vs Happiness:",
          input$year
        ),
        x = "Health Equality Group",
        y = "Happiness Score (0-10)"
      ) +

      theme_minimal() +

      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
      )

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  })


  # PART 7: Summary table

  output$summary_table <- renderTable({

    df <- filtered_data()

    req(nrow(df) >= 3)

    df %>%
      group_by(Health_Group) %>%
      summarise(
        Countries = n(),
        Mean_Happiness = round(mean(happiness), 2),
        Median_Happiness = round(median(happiness), 2),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })


  # PART 8: Country count

  output$country_count <- renderText({

    paste(
      "Countries displayed:",
      nrow(filtered_data())
    )
  })


  # PART 9: Reset filters

  observeEvent(input$reset, {

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "year",
      value = 2022
    )

    updateSelectInput(
      session,
      "continent",
      selected = "All Continents"
    )
  })

}


# PART 10: Run the Shiny app

shinyApp(ui, server)

```
